Names and compatibility

Current GateFox names and the compatibility identities used by existing installations and saved chats.

About 2 min read · 3 sections

On this page
01 Current names 02 Existing installations 03 Saved chats

GateFox is the current product name. Harness Gateway and Subscription Gateway remain in some stored identities that installed services and saved chats use. These are supported compatibility identities, not unfinished rename work.

Current names

Surface Name
App GateFox.app
Commands gatefox, gateway and harness-gateway run the same gateway
Stable release tag vVERSION
App download GateFox-VERSION-macos-arm64.zip
CLI download gatefox-VERSION-macos-arm64.tar.gz
New gateway chat provider gatefox

See releasing for publication and app updates for signed installation and rollback.

Existing installations

Fresh installations use ~/.local/share/gatefox and, on macOS, ~/Library/Application Support/GateFox/gateway.json. An existing installation can retain ~/.local/share/subscription-gateway and ~/Library/Application Support/Subscription Gateway/gateway.json; updates keep using those locations. Updates do not promise a folder or LaunchAgent rename. See the Mac app for configuration discovery.

The following identities must not be removed as cosmetic cleanup:

Identity Why it remains
com.edihasaj.subscription-gateway* LaunchAgent labels and ownership markers They identify existing managed services and their recovery records.
com.edihasaj.harness-gateway.app bundle ID Keeping it preserves the app's signing identity, permissions and background association.
HARNESS_GATEWAY_EXECUTOR alongside GATEFOX_EXECUTOR Running executors and SDKs may read either marker.
Symbol.for("harness-gateway/…") registry keys Loaded releases share live sessions and ownership through these keys.
A Harness Gateway.app compatibility link A loaded service can still refer to that path until its next natural start.

App relocation accepts only the verified sibling app relationship described in app updates. It does not authorize changing arbitrary app paths or macOS privacy records.

Saved chats

Current gateway executors register both gatefox and subscription_gateway. Existing chats keep opening under their recorded provider ID; migration is optional. A resume never rewrites a chat's provider identity.

gateway chats migrate previews a supported saved-chat migration; --revert previews the reverse direction. To make changes, quit ChatGPT and stop the gateway service normally, then use --apply or --apply --revert. The command requires the canonical provider registration, backs up the database, and preserves native chats. It updates rollout metadata before database rows so an interrupted migration can be resumed. Keep the generated backups.

See harness identity for the full saved-chat contract.
